name: Leonardo
summary: Image platform for teams that need a consistent style, with custom model training and real API access.
description:
Leonardo built for the boring-but-valuable case: keep a visual identity across hundreds of assets. Fine-tuning on your own references, control over resolution and tiling, and asset-oriented features make it a common pick in game art and marketing production, where a style that survives a hundred images beats one beautiful render.

Raw peak quality is not its claim — the frontier models are better at surprises. Token-metered plans and per-generation costs need modelling before you commit a pipeline to it, and self-hosted alternatives exist for teams that care about running the weights themselves.
